issues.description: changedFiles path comparison may fail due to absolute vs relative path mismatch
issues.detail: In isIncluded, filename is slash(cleanUrl(_filename)) which could be absolute, while VitestGit.findChangedFiles typically returns absolute paths but config.related may differ. The `this.changedFiles.includes(filename)` strict equality check is fragile if paths differ in casing, normalization, or absoluteness. A path-set or normalized comparison would be safer.

issues.description: onTestRunStart not awaited before generateCoverage in some paths can cause race
issues.detail: In core.ts the new `await this.coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.()` is added, but onTestRunStart mutates this.changedFiles which `resolveFiles` and `isIncluded` rely on. If any earlier hook (e.g. onAfterSuiteRun via worker) consults isIncluded before onTestRunStart resolves the git diff, results may be stale. Consider initializing changedFiles earlier in provider initialization.

issues.description: Silent fallback when findChangedFiles returns null leaves coverage unfiltered
issues.detail: If `vitestGit.findChangedFiles` returns null (e.g. not a git repo, or git command fails), `this.changedFiles` becomes undefined and coverage silently includes ALL files. This is the opposite of user intent and should at minimum emit a warning, otherwise CI consumers may publish full coverage thinking they got a filtered view.

issues.description: CLI transform accepts boolean values it cannot receive
issues.detail: The transform checks `value === true` and `value === false` but CLI input is always a string. More importantly, for `--coverage.changed` without a value the argument parser likely passes `true` (boolean) — the string checks `'true'`/`'yes'` are unusual for vitest CLI conventions and not documented. Confirm whether boolean shortcut is reachable; otherwise dead code.

`test/coverage-test/test/changed.test.ts` changed mode from non-executable to 100755. TypeScript test files should not be executable; this is likely accidental from the contributor's local environment and should be reverted to keep file permissions consistent across the repo.

issues.description: globCache cleared in onTestRunStart but isIncluded may have been called earlier
issues.detail: Clearing the glob cache in onTestRunStart is correct, but if any code path calls `isIncluded` before onTestRunStart (e.g. during setup or speculative include checks), cached values from before changedFiles was set could persist briefly. Adding an explicit invalidation guard or computing changedFiles during _initialize would be more robust.

review.summary: The PR adds a useful `coverage.changed` option with reasonable resolveConfig wiring, documentation, and tests. Main concerns are around robustness of the changed-file filtering: path equality comparison in isIncluded is fragile, the silent fallback when git lookup fails could yield full coverage instead of filtered, and the onTestRunStart hook timing creates a small window where isIncluded results could be stale. The CLI boolean transform and an accidental executable bit on a test file are minor cleanups.
